title: HB1575 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 10-7-504; Section 33-6-413; Section 38-8-116; Section 39-16-702; Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Section 70-2-104, relative to handguns.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-04-05; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2771434)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-04-05). Sections 3-18 only delete cross-references to 39-17-1366 in other laws; omitted. Repealing 39-17-1366 removes the section's text, which is not reproduced.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1366): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1366, is amended by deleting the section.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(z)): (1) A person who holds a concealed handgun carry permit pursuant to § 39-17-1366 that is active on June 30, 2023, may apply to the department to convert the person's concealed handgun carry permit to an enhanced handgun carry permit.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(z)): (2) In order to be eligible to convert a concealed handgun carry permit to an enhanced handgun carry permit, a person must provide proof of completion of the training requirements in subsection (e).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(z)): (3) An enhanced handgun carry permit issued pursuant to this subsection (z) is active until the expiration date issued on the person's concealed handgun carry permit held on June 30, 2023.
